identity.title: Circular Polarization of Simulated Images of Black Holes

paper_type_evidence.quote: In this paper we compare unresolved circular polarization (CP) measurements to a library of models, where each model is characterized by a distribution of CP over time.
For Sgr A\* the observations from ALMA given in (cite: bower_alma_2018) and (cite: wielgus_orbital_2022) are used as a constraint on the CP

question.value: Which GRMHD/GRRT black hole models produce net circular polarization (v_net) consistent with unresolved ALMA 1.3 mm measurements of Sgr A* and M87*, and how does v_net depend on model parameters?

evidence.quote: We find that ALMA observations of Sgr A\* are inconsistent with all edge-on ($i = 90^\circ$) models.

evidence.quote: the average flux is within $5\%$ of $0.7$ Jy and $2.4$ Jy, respectively

validation.value: Convergence tests with time, GRMHD and GRRT resolution

evidence.quote: the $v_\mathrm{net}$ distributions appear converged with respect to GRMHD resolution and GRRT image resolution.

analysis_steps.goal: Compare model v_net distributions to ALMA data

method.value: Two-sided KS test between model (sampled every 400M) and observations; fail if both aligned and reversed field give p<0.01

evidence.quote: The model is sampled every 400M to obtain an approximately uncorrelated sample.
giving 99% confidence in rejecting the null hypothesis that the model and observations arose from the same distribution.

findings_qualitative.value: Edge-on models produce v_net≈0 and are disfavored; passing MAD models have dipole moment pointing away from observer and clockwise rotation

evidence.quote: We also note that in 26 of the 27 passing MAD models the accretion flow rotates clockwise on the sky.

claims.hypothesis: Do ALMA unresolved CP data constrain Sgr A* models?
claims.experiment: KS tests of model v_net distributions against ALMA data
claims.result: All edge-on MAD models fail; passing MADs have field pointing away from observer
claims.finding: CP constrains inclination, field direction and flow rotation

evidence.quote: only models with magnetic dipole moment pointing away from the observer are consistent with ALMA data.

claims.hypothesis: Best-bet EHT models are consistent with CP
claims.finding: Prograde high-R_high low inclination MADs do not give sufficient CP

evidence.quote: All the best-bet models given in fail the CP constraint.

limitations_admitted.value: Models highly variable with frequent v_net sign crossings unlike observations

evidence.quote: The primary caveat is that the models are highly variable in Stokes I and V when compared to Sgr A\*.

referee_caveats_inferred: Single GRMHD library with fixed adiabatic index and thermal electrons

evidence.quote: It is publicly available at <https://github.com/AFD-Illinois/kharma>.
